estar_yo_estoy_vs_esta.label: yo + estoy (not está) for self
estar_yo_estoy_vs_esta.teach_hint: Learner confuses *estoy* (I am) with *está* (he/she/it/usted is). Recast *Yo está…* → *Estoy…* / *Yo estoy…*; weave first-person location and wellbeing with *estoy*.

me_llamo_es.label: me llamo (not me llama es)
me_llamo_es.teach_hint: Recast *Me llama es X* / *Me llamo es X* → *Me llamo X*.

soy_de_origin.label: soy de + place
soy_de_origin.teach_hint: Origin needs *de*: *Soy de Estados Unidos* (not *Soy Estados Unidos*).

ser_estar_confuse.label: ser vs estar (feelings / location / temporary state)
ser_estar_confuse.teach_hint: Feelings and location use *estar* (*Estoy nerviosa*, *Estoy en casa*). *Ser* is for identity/origin (*Soy estudiante*, *Soy de…*). Recast *Soy nerviosa* → *Estoy nerviosa*; *Soy bien* → *Estoy bien*.

gender_number_article.label: article/noun gender-number agreement
gender_number_article.teach_hint: Match article and noun: *el edificio* / *los edificios* / *la casa* / *las casas*. Recast *la edificios* → *los edificios*; *el casas* → *las casas*.

weather_hace.label: weather: hace calor/frío (not está calor)
weather_hace.teach_hint: Weather heat/cold uses *hace*: *Hace calor*, *Hace frío*, *Hace buen tiempo*. Not *está calor* / *es calor*. (*Está caliente* is for things, not the weather.)

greeting_agreement_buenos_buenas.label: buenos/buenas agreement in greetings
greeting_agreement_buenos_buenas.teach_hint: Fixed phrases agree: buenos días (m) but buenas tardes/noches (f). Recast *buenos tardes → buenas tardes.

register_tu_with_usted_person.label: tú forms with an usted person
register_tu_with_usted_person.teach_hint: estás/te llamas directed at a boss, elder, or stranger — switch to está usted / se llama.

mucho_gusto_literal.label: mucho gusto read literally
mucho_gusto_literal.teach_hint: It is a fixed pleased-to-meet-you formula, not about taste; reply igualmente.

gender_exception_rule.label: -o/-a rule applied to exception nouns
gender_exception_rule.teach_hint: el día/mapa/problema, la mano/foto/moto — drill as a closed set; learner produces el problema / los problemas + one original.

gender_from_meaning.label: gender justified by real-world meaning
gender_from_meaning.teach_hint: Gender belongs to the WORD, not the object (*la vestido from 'a dress is feminine'). Teach: learn noun with its article.

el_vs_el_accent.label: el (the) vs él (he) accent
el_vs_el_accent.teach_hint: Accent distinguishes words: él es… vs el libro. Contrast in writing.

pronoun_every_sentence.label: subject pronoun in every clause
pronoun_every_sentence.teach_hint: Spanish drops pronouns unless contrasting: Soy de México, not Yo soy… Yo no soy… every line.

usted_second_person_verb.label: usted with 2nd-person verb
usted_second_person_verb.teach_hint: usted/ustedes take THIRD-person forms: usted es, not *usted eres.

profession_article.label: article before unmodified profession
profession_article.teach_hint: Soy estudiante, not *soy un estudiante (article returns with an adjective: es un profesor excelente).

vosotros_in_latam.label: vosotros hunted in a Latin American context
vosotros_in_latam.teach_hint: ustedes is BOTH formal and informal plural in Latin America; vosotros is Spain.

ser_for_location.label: ser for physical location
ser_for_location.teach_hint: Where → estar: Madrid está en España (the strongest evidence against the permanent/temporary shortcut).

permanent_temporary_shortcut.label: ser=permanent / estar=temporary shortcut
permanent_temporary_shortcut.teach_hint: The shortcut misfires (está muerto; Madrid está…). Teach what/how/where instead.

ser_estar_interchangeable.label: ser/estar treated as interchangeable
ser_estar_interchangeable.teach_hint: Don't correct item-by-item: teach the decision rule, then have the learner SAY the reason (what/how/where) before answering.

accent_esta_vs_esta.label: está written without its accent
accent_esta_vs_esta.teach_hint: esta (this) vs está (is) — the accent is part of the verb's spelling, never optional.

infinitive_unconjugated.label: bare infinitive as the verb
infinitive_unconjugated.teach_hint: *Yo hablar español → hablo. The infinitive is the dictionary form, not a usable present.

wrong_ending_family.label: one ending set for all families
wrong_ending_family.teach_hint: -ar endings on -er/-ir verbs (*comas for comes): theme vowel follows the family.

er_ir_overdistinguish.label: -er/-ir imagined to differ everywhere
er_ir_overdistinguish.teach_hint: They differ ONLY in nosotros/vosotros: comemos vs vivimos.

estar_plus_infinitive.label: estar + infinitive for progressive
estar_plus_infinitive.teach_hint: *Estoy comer → como. Simple present covers 'am eating' at A1 (no progressive yet).

question_do_auxiliary.label: do-auxiliary inserted in questions
question_do_auxiliary.teach_hint: *¿Haces tú hablar inglés? → ¿Hablas inglés? Intonation or inversion, never an auxiliary.

age_with_ser.label: age with ser/estar
age_with_ser.teach_hint: *Soy veinte años → Tengo veinte años (always include años).

tener_regularized.label: tener conjugated as regular -er
tener_regularized.teach_hint: *teno/*tenes → tengo, tienes (memorize the six as a unit).

compound_number_split.label: compound numbers mis-split
compound_number_split.teach_hint: 21–29 ONE word (veintidós); 31–99 three words (treinta y dos). Probe: veintidós ↔ treinta y dos.

cuanto_agreement.label: cuánto not agreeing with its noun
cuanto_agreement.teach_hint: cuánto/a/os/as agrees in gender AND number: ¿Cuántas sillas hay?

porque_vs_por_que.label: porque (because) vs ¿por qué? (why)
porque_vs_por_que.teach_hint: Question form is two words with an accent: ¿Por qué…? Answer: porque…
